lines.en: I move fast and low over the ground.
My foreclaws land first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地测着距离
lines.en: I measure the ground, step by step.
I make a circuit of the plains.
My tail steadies me behind.
I lift a foreclaw and set it down.
I head back toward my anchor.
I come down the grassy slope.
I lower my snout and sniff the soil.
I turn and walk a few steps to you.
My claws take a good grip.
I press forward inch by inch.
I stand with my foreclaws bent.

lines.zh: 我盯着锚点那边的动静
lines.en: I watch for movement by the anchor.
I can see through you even in the dark.
This place is wide open.
I sway my long tail slowly.
Wind passes my horns.

lines.zh: 地面把远处的脚步传给我
lines.en: The ground passes distant footsteps to me.
I stand without stirring.

lines.zh: 我把爪尖一个个试过地面
lines.en: I test the ground with each claw tip.
I am thinking about the next move.
I raise my head to the distance.
I want for nothing here.
There is a sheen on my hide.

lines.zh: 我把胸口那口气沉下去
lines.en: I let the breath settle in my chest.
You are standing at my feet.
I lower my head square at you.
I know a trainer.
Just point me a direction.
I can dig for you.
My foreclaws are sharp.
I am waiting for your order.

lines.zh: 你身上有数据流的气味
lines.en: You carry the smell of a data stream.
I blink my eyes once.
Where do you intend to go?
Let me show you my claws.
I sit down beside you.
When do we set out?
Is something worrying you?
I hold my head up, steady.
I will walk along with you.

lines.zh: 这一爪划开了我的肩甲
lines.en: That claw opens my shoulder plate.
A gash is opened in my hide.
I will remember that claw.
I shift half a pace aside.
I shake my claws.
I settle my weight.
My four claws still hold.
This body can fight on.
I clamp my jaw.
I slowly get my breath back.
Is that thing meat?
I step once toward you.
I dip my head and sniff.
This little bit is not enough.
Lay it on the ground first.
I finish it in two or three bites.
This beats what I find in the wild.
I keep my eyes on that hand.
Raw or cooked, I swallow both.
I look up, still wanting.
Do not take your hand away.
I can catch this myself.
You struck the plate on my chest.
I did not yield half a step.
I blocked you.
You stepped on my foreclaw.
I angle my body to let you by.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我稳住了
lines.en: We collide, and I hold.
That was nothing.
Do not walk so close to me.
My tail props up my balance.
Just step aside.
I was raised for training.
I rarely think of such things.

lines.zh: 锚点在哪，我的位置就在哪
lines.en: Where the anchor is, I am.
That subject need not come up.
I twist my head aside.
I turn and keep walking.
I can fight alone.
These plains are good.
I lift a claw.
I did not answer a word.
I pick it up and weigh it.
Can this be eaten?
I pin it under one foreclaw.
Too hard; I only break off a corner.
It slips from my teeth.
Whoever dropped it, I keep it.

lines.zh: 这东西碍着我的爪子了
lines.en: This thing is in the way of my claws.
This thing has no taste.
I press it into the soil.
I bring it over to show you.
Something has come near.
I have turned around.
My claws dig in.
It is fixed in my sight.
I take my place ahead of you.
My twin horns are lowered.
It is close enough to me now.
I am about to loose my arrow.
It should not have come near.
I lower my body.
I count from the third.
My foreclaws are already dug in.
I narrow the gap bit by bit.
My tail pulls into a line.
I watch which step you take first.
I count every claw swipe it makes.
It backs off, and I follow.
I stand between the two of you.
I am hunting its opening.
My horns stay on it.
It has come into my circle.
I close the gap to one claw's reach.
I do not mean to miss this.
I am ready on this side.
I throw myself at it.
My claws tear into it.
The hit sends it stumbling back.
That blow came down hard.
I slash again.
It slips aside.
My tail catches it.
It backs off; I stay where I am.
My horns crash into its shoulder.
I am still ahead of you.
I have a scrape on me.
I can lunge once more.

lines.zh: 我从数据流里凝出形来
lines.en: I take shape out of the data stream.
My anchor has settled on this plain.

lines.zh: 我的爪子第一次踩上土
lines.en: My claws touch soil for the first time.
I lift my head and scan the area.

lines.zh: 数据的光从甲缝里褪去
lines.en: Data-light fades from my seams.
My foreclaws press the ground.
This place is open enough.

lines.zh: 我选了个能看清四周的位置
lines.en: I took a spot with a clear view.
I give a short, sharp call.
I settle low slowly.
I plant myself, claws gripping the ground.
I glance at you, then look away.
Fire burns my hide.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我侧身卸了力
lines.en: I roll sideways to shed the fall.
Water chokes down my throat.
The blast sends me rolling.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder plate.
Magic scrambles my data.
Hunger makes my claws shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我压低身子
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I flatten.
There is nothing under my feet.
